description: This file defines a singleton service class 'Services' that manages dependencies related to notes functionality, including repository, database, DAO, and API components. It provides initialization, reset, and access methods for app-wide services.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: A singleton class that provides centralized access to notes data-related services such as repository, DAO, database, and API components. Supports asynchronous initialization and test reset.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance with default or provided repository, setting up database, DAO, API, and repository components asynchronously.

methods.name: resetForTest
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance to null, intended for testing purposes to ensure isolation between tests.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the already-initialized singleton instance; throws an error if called before initialization.
